sloka: कुरुष्व हितवादिन्या वचनं मम मैथिलि ।अलमश्रुप्रपातेन त्यज शोकमनर्थकम् ।। ५.२२.२७।।।।
transliteration: kuruṣva hitavādinyā vacanaṁ mama maithili ।alamaśruprapātena tyaja śokamanarthakam ।। 5.22.27।।।।

translations.english: The lord of demons shone like mount Mandara, both his long two arms like two mountain peaks.
